name: k8s_cron_job
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes CronJob — a scheduled workload that runs jobs on a recurring cron schedule within an environment or resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Kubernetes cron job.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes cron job resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the cron job runs.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the cron job runs.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace to run the cron job in.

attributes.name: is_any_host_allowed
attributes.description: When true, the cron job pods may be scheduled on any available host.

attributes.name: allocation_tags
attributes.description: Allocation tags used to constrain which hosts the cron job pods run on.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Labels to apply to the Kubernetes CronJob object.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Annotations to apply to the Kubernetes CronJob object.

attributes.name: schedule
attributes.description: Cron schedule expression (e.g. "0 2 * * *" for 2 AM daily).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone name for the schedule (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to the cluster time zone.

attributes.name: concurrency_policy
attributes.description: How to treat concurrent executions: Allow (default), Forbid, or Replace.

attributes.name: starting_deadline_seconds
attributes.description: Seconds after the scheduled time within which a missed run may still start.

attributes.name: successful_jobs_history_limit
attributes.description: Number of successful finished jobs to retain. Defaults to 3.

attributes.name: failed_jobs_history_limit
attributes.description: Number of failed finished jobs to retain. Defaults to 1.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: When true, subsequent scheduled executions are suspended.

attributes.name: backoff_limit
attributes.description: Number of retries before a job run is marked as failed. Defaults to 6.

attributes.name: completions
attributes.description: Number of pods that must succeed for each job run to be considered complete.

attributes.name: parallelism
attributes.description: Maximum number of pods running in parallel for each job run.

attributes.name: ttl_seconds_after_finished
attributes.description: Seconds after a job run finishes before it is automatically deleted. Omit to disable automatic cleanup.

attributes.name: active_deadline_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum duration in seconds a job run may execute before being terminated.

attributes.name: restart_policy
attributes.description: Pod restart policy. Use Never (default) or OnFailure for batch jobs.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes service account to run the pods as.

attributes.name: node_selector
attributes.description: Node label selector constraints for pod scheduling.

attributes.name: containers
attributes.description: List of containers to run in each job pod.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Container name.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Container image (e.g. my-repo/my-image:latest).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Entrypoint command array (overrides the image ENTRYPOINT).

attributes.name: args
attributes.description: Arguments to the entrypoint command (overrides the image CMD).

attributes.name: working_dir
attributes.description: Container working directory.

attributes.name: env
attributes.description: Environment variables to set in the container.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Environment variable name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Environment variable value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the cron job resource.

attributes.name: active_job_names
attributes.description: Names of job runs currently active for this cron job.

attributes.name: last_schedule_time
attributes.description: Time the cron job last scheduled a run.

attributes.name: last_successful_time
attributes.description: Time a run of the cron job last completed successfully.
